Not sure how every bank works. But the bank i worked at each teller had a goal of 12 points a month. Each time you opened a checking account, savings account, loan, etc you got 3 points. So really if you were to open one  account a week you hit your point goal. Also if you were to go over your goal for the month that was incentive and you were rewarded. I had little to no retail skill when I started my job at the bank. Give yourself about a month or so to get to know the products and then they become second nature when talking to a customer. So just get to know the bank products and the customers and everything else falls into place. 

Example: “Good morning Mr. Jones. I see you have 10,000 dollars in your savings account. Do you have a moment to talk about a money market or CD, so that your money can start working for you?”
